scope: EGW Writings / Adventist Pioneer Library / Pioneer Authors (folder 16) only

method.book_list_source: Archived server-rendered EGW Writings legacy pages (m.egwwritings.org/en/folders/16 and author subfolders) via Wayback Machine; live egwwritings.org and a.egwwritings.org block anonymous scripted access (Cloudflare challenge / OAuth 401).
method.code_source: Archived m.egwwritings.org/en/book/{id}/info pages (Book Code field, EGW metadata).
method.availability_source: LIVE HTTP HEAD checks against https://media2.egwwritings.org/{fmt}/en_{CODE}.{fmt} (EGW Writings own media host, same pattern the eLibrary download service uses). No files downloaded.

acquisition_rule: Use EGW Writings EPUB (media2.egwwritings.org) first when available; use CaptureClipper/.studybook package for everything else; EllenWhiteAudio and other prior sources are excluded.
